Executive summary

Kestrel predicts maintenance events for commercial truck fleets using telematics feeds, and schedules service before a vehicle fails in transit.

The business is a commercial fleet maintenance software platform founded in 2018 and employing 73 people from its Austin, Texas headquarters. Approximately 95% of total revenue is recurring subscription revenue; revenue grew 22% year over year in FY25.

Model quality improves with fleet-miles observed, and the data asset is difficult for a new entrant to assemble.
